scripts.01-redis:cluster: docker compose -f 01-redis/docker-compose.yml up -d redis-node-1 redis-node-2 redis-node-3 && docker compose -f 01-redis/docker-compose.yml run --rm redis-cluster-setup
scripts.03-replicaset: npm run 03-replicaset:db && docker compose -f 03-replicaset/docker-compose.yml up app
scripts.03-replicaset:db: docker compose -f 03-replicaset/docker-compose.yml up -d mongodb-primary mongodb-secondary-1 mongodb-secondary-2 && docker compose -f 03-replicaset/docker-compose.yml run --rm replica-setup
scripts.05-load-balancing:reload: docker compose -f 05-load-balancing/docker-compose.yml exec nginx nginx -t && docker compose -f 05-load-balancing/docker-compose.yml exec nginx nginx -s reload
